# QS-CFW-7434-20 Quality specification - connecting rod CFW-7434-20 (1045)

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P2  
Parts: CFW-7434-20

Scope
- This document defines quality requirements, inspection methods, and nonconformance handling for connecting rod CFW-7434-20 forged from 1045 material produced at Plant P2. Applicable to finished forgings delivered to downstream machining and assembly.

Requirements table
| Characteristic | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Material | 1045 forging designated CFW-7434-20 |
| Hardness (post-forge, through-thickness) | 26-30 HRC |
| Bore diameter tolerance (after finish-boring) | ±0.07 mm |
| Maximum forging weight | 101.0 kg |

Inspection method
- Visual and dimensional inspection shall be performed on each production lot per standard shop practices. Validate bore diameter using calibrated bore gauge suitable for the feature; record as-found value and confirm compliance with the stated tolerance. Verify hardness by Rockwell method at representative locations across the cross section; report values and confirm they lie within the stated range. Confirm forging weight by scale measurement at receiving; ensure each forging does not exceed the stated maximum weight. All instruments used must be calibrated and traceable to plant calibration records.

- Record keeping: capture inspection data in the lot inspection record. Include part number, lot identifier, inspector initials, measurement results for hardness, bore diameter, and weight, and a final disposition statement.

Nonconformance handling
- Any part that fails to meet the listed requirements is nonconforming. Segregate nonconforming parts immediately and apply a nonconformance tag. Initiate a containment action and notify quality engineering. Disposition shall be documented and may include rework, scrap, or use-as-is only if an approved engineering deviation exists. Root cause and corrective action must be recorded prior to release of similar future lots.

Revision control
- This is Rev B of QS-CFW-7434-20.
